name: repair_peer
description: Repair requests this validator has sent to one peer, and what came back, as running totals. Emitted by the rotor tile once a second, on whole wall-clock seconds, for every peer the repair strategy knows (staked peers first, by stake rank, then unstaked peers with an address), idle or not; at most 2000 rows per second, the rest are skipped that second. Totals count from when the repair strategy last learned the peer and restart at 0 if it forgets the peer, so a decrease marks a restart. Requests are counted, not shreds: a request may ask for several shreds of one FEC set and counts as answered on its first reply.

ip.description: IPv4 address requests were sent to, stored as an IPv4-mapped IPv6 address (all zeros if gossip has no address for the peer).

port.description: UDP port of the peer's serve-repair endpoint (0 if unknown).

staked.description: Whether the peer is staked in the current epoch, as ranked by the repair strategy.

req_cnt.description: Repair requests sent to the peer.

res_cnt.description: Requests answered: the first reply matched to an outstanding request.

exp_cnt.description: Requests that expired unanswered, including requests no peer could answer yet (highest-index and orphan requests, or below the root), which do not count toward a ban.

ban_cnt.description: Times the peer was banned from requests: for a reply that failed verification (a metadata reply whose proof did not check), or for a run of unanswered requests (32 in a row, or 4 by-id).

out_cnt.description: Requests outstanding when the row was emitted.

srtt_ns.description: Smoothed round-trip time to the peer when the row was emitted (RFC 6298), 0 if never measured.

rttvar_ns.description: Mean deviation of the round-trip time, 0 if never measured.

turbine_srtt_ns.description: As leader, smoothed time from a FEC set's first shred to the FEC set completing at this validator, by turbine or repair (RFC 6298), 0 if never measured. Once turbine_cnt reaches 8, repair of this leader's blocks waits turbine_srtt_ns+4*turbine_rttvar_ns, clamped to 20-250 ms, before asking for a FEC set; before that it waits the estimate across all leaders.

turbine_rttvar_ns.description: Mean deviation of the turbine time, 0 if never measured.

turbine_cnt.description: FEC sets of this leader that completed at this validator, the samples behind turbine_srtt_ns.
